Static Bump Map

Source: R/mp_bumpmap.R
mp_bumpmap.Rd

Creates a map with sigmoid curves linking each state (or municipality) to a side ranking of the number of dengue cases (DNG, DWS and SD).

mp_bumpmap(
  dataset,
  year,
  state = TRUE,
  pal_vir = "viridis",
  cve_edo = NULL,
  axis_start = NULL,
  country_text_x = NULL,
  country_text_y = NULL,
  size_text_value = 2,
  size_text_country = 2,
  line_size = 1,
  value_text = NULL,
  label_spacing = NULL,
  top_n = NULL,
  label_line = 1.6,
  label_width = 0.4,
  smooth = 10
)

Arguments

dataset

data.frame with the SINAVE dengue dataset.

year

year to plot (ANO column).

state

logical. TRUE = national map by state; FALSE = municipalities of the state given in `cve_edo`.

pal_vir

viridis palette option ("viridis", "magma", "inferno", "plasma", "cividis", "turbo", ...).

cve_edo

two-digit INEGI state code (e.g. "14"). Only used when `state = FALSE`.

axis_start

distance (in degrees) between the map edge and the end of the curves. Defaults to 5 with `state = TRUE` and 0.5 with `state = FALSE`.

country_text_x

leftward offset of the name. With `state = FALSE` it is measured from the end of the straight segment (default 0.02).

country_text_y

vertical offset of the name. With `state = FALSE` it is the height of the text above its line (default 0.005).

size_text_value

text size of the number of cases.

size_text_country

text size of the name.

line_size

width of the sigmoid curves.

value_text

with `state = FALSE`, gap (in degrees) between the end of the straight segment and the number of cases (default 0.05).

label_spacing

`state = FALSE` only: vertical spacing (in degrees) between ranking rows. If NULL, the rows are spread over the height of the state. Increase it (e.g. 0.04 - 0.08) if names overlap.

top_n

`state = FALSE` only: number of municipalities with the most cases to show in the ranking. NULL = all.

label_line

`state = FALSE` only: length (in degrees) of the straight segment that follows each curve; the municipality name is written on it. Increase it if long names extend past the segment (default 1.6).

label_width

`state = FALSE` only: space (in degrees) reserved to the right of the number of cases so it is not clipped.

smooth

smoothness of the sigmoid curves.

Value

a ggplot object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
dataset <- data.table::fread("DENGUE2_.txt", quote = "", fill = TRUE)
static_bump_map(dataset = dataset, year = 2026, state = TRUE,
                size_text_value = 2, size_text_country = 2,
                country_text_x = 0.5, country_text_y = 0.8,
                line_size = 1.5, pal_vir = "viridis")
static_bump_map(dataset = dataset, year = 2026, state = FALSE,
                cve_edo = "14", label_spacing = 0.05,
                size_text_value = 2, size_text_country = 2,
                line_size = 0.6, pal_vir = "turbo")
} # }
